summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli; every file under 400 lines, no import cycles or upward imports), removed the old module, and updated digest.py imports and the mock.patch targets in tests.
